reviews.text: The staff were very friendly, and I especially want to thank vet Vanessa for the guidance she gave us to improve my dog ​​Chester's health. Both he and I were treated with great care. Thank you.
They were very attentive; I took my dog ​​in for some injuries to his eyes and they treated him with love and care, always monitoring his improvement.
they've treated my cat and my dog <3

We went with my German Shepherd, and they did blood and urine tests and an ultrasound. They have their own lab, which is great, the service was excellent, and I left feeling much more at ease. The center is conveniently located and has long opening hours. We already have a follow-up appointment scheduled for a few months from now, and I know for sure it will be one of my go-to clinics.

Unfortunately, they are not professional. They didn't treat our cat well, and as such, we filed a complaint with the appropriate authorities. Fortunately, two months later, the entire animal trafficking and malpractice related to that clinic was exposed.
A nightmare of a clinic. Not recommended!
Search the name of the center and watch the TV3 news report; it has all the information related to the arrests that were made.
All good!

Dr. H. is extremely professional. He discovered two ulcers on our Labrador and proceeded immediately with surgery. During the postoperative period, he answered our calls every day, providing extremely thorough follow-up. A truly great professional. Veterinarian and ophthalmologist.
Dr. H did an excellent job treating my cat Lucy. He kept her so calm while drawing her blood and vaccinating her without stressing her out. He was very gentle with her. Excellent service.
Very good experience with Dr. H

I went to the emergency room with my kitten, they were very kind and took her in immediately due to the kitten's critical situation, sadly they couldn't save her due to the severity, but both she and I were treated quickly and accompanied at all times ❤️ Thank you very much!
Excellent service from all the staff. Hermógenes is a true professional. He always explains everything to us with great patience and dedication so we can understand it. Thank you so much!! ❤️
Terrible treatment at reception, plus numerous administrative errors, and they tried to charge more at the time of my dog's surgery than the authorized quote stated.

I've been taking my dog ​​Runa to this veterinary clinic for seven years. The service is excellent. From the receptionists/assistants who always have a smile and are patient with the owners and their furry friends, to the highly professional veterinarians, and finally the surgeons who do an incredible job. Our vet is Sara, all sweetness and smiles. She always remembers that Runa, like any good pug, doesn't carry her weight very well... but with her help, we'll get there. You can also buy pet food, and they recommend dental cleaning products and supplements. If you're in the Eixample Esquerra area, this is the clinic for you.

I'm very happy with the care and service provided. They take pet emergencies very seriously, never putting off needs that require immediate attention. Diagnoses are based on tests, not speculative conclusions. Overall, a top-notch service.
I was there a month ago and everything went very well. I loved that the vet who treated my cat suggested a preventative treatment with natural products; I like this approach.

I stopped taking my dogs there after a serious vet error resulted in my dog ​​losing an eye and nearly dying. Luckily, I caught it in time, and another veterinary hospital saved his life. Never again.

My dog ​​Max recently had surgery. We are very happy with the care he received.
Dr. Hermogenes was excellent, a 10 out of 10! The staff were lovely. Thank you so much!
Marta, Max's mom

I'm very happy with my overall experience at this clinic. We went in for an "emergency" appointment, and both the reception staff and Dr. Salazar were kind and incredibly attentive throughout.
Dr. Salazar explained the procedure to me from the very beginning, outlining all the possible scenarios, so I was fully informed of the pros and cons. He explained her progress in detail at each follow-up visit.

Fortunately, everything has gone perfectly for my dog, and we are very grateful for the care and professionalism. We will definitely return if we need another ophthalmologist. 😉

As I mentioned in my review, and as I told the surgeon/attendant who saw my dog, he was NOT examined at any of his vaccination appointments, except for the last one. Although he didn't seem interested at all, since he wouldn't even look at me when I brought it up.

Furthermore, it would be absurd if you administered the vaccines incorrectly.
Regarding my dog's oral health, I went because he had lost a tooth. On the one hand, I find it strange that he went from zero to a cleaning with anesthesia in 10 months, and above all, I find his diagnosis strange because he didn't even look at his mouth.

And of course, you won't be the ones treating him.
We are very happy with the service and attention at the veterinary clinic. All the staff were very friendly, professional, and attentive at all times. We definitely recommend it highly.
Love them!

They're not professionals. For eight years, I've brought my dog ​​here for vaccinations, and only on the last visit did they give him a basic check-up, during which they didn't tell me he had tartar problems. Ten months later, I returned because he'd lost a tooth, and they told me he needed a cleaning under general anesthesia and probably more teeth to be extracted! The surgeon who saw me, and the person in charge at the time, didn't even acknowledge the other veterinarian's mistake. He just tried to sell me various treatments.
Very friendly and efficient. Highly recommended.
As always, everything was perfect. Both the veterinarians and all the staff are absolutely delightful and very professional.
This is a clinic we trust; we always leave very happy. Roonie loves going there, and the receptionists always give her a treat. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for such excellent service.
Good service and professionalism
Always great

I've been taking my dog ​​to this clinic for a while now, and recently they've also treated him for a urinary problem. The care has always been fantastic. I especially want to highlight Dr. Sara, who has been excellent: very professional, friendly, and attentive at all times.

All the staff have always been wonderful. They've taken great care of me in all the emergencies we've had and have genuinely cared about my dog's progress, even following up with me by phone.

I'm very grateful for the treatment, dedication, and care with which they work. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic.
Carera Clinic is better; I don't recommend taking your animals to another clinic.
The clinic is great, Dr. Hermógenes has always taken excellent care of my dog, and the reception staff are very friendly 🌻♥️ …
The surgeon I think his name is Hermojones is fantastic ! The people are so kind and you can anytime contact the hospital and someone in English will help which is a big plus.

Super professional, punctual, and incredibly friendly... words can't do them justice. Starting with the receptionists, one is Meritxell and I don't know the other's name. And Dr. Hache, you can tell he loves his job. Professional and very attentive to everything, always smiling from the moment we walked in until the end of Duke's visit. He explains everything very well. I highly recommend them. We come from Castelldefels and will continue to come back whenever Duke needs it because we know he's in good hands. Thank you so much, team!
They were very helpful and professional, I’ve been a couple of times with my dog Alfonso
This is our trusted clinic; we really appreciate the way they treat people and dogs. They're always supportive and take their time.
Our go-to veterinary clinic. All the staff are both professional and kind. They treat our dog with such gentleness and care; we couldn't be happier.

Everything was perfect! We got an appointment super fast, and they treated Ramirez (🐶) wonderfully! With a lot of patience, we were able to get the test done without any problems. They explained everything and gave us great advice. We'll definitely be going back ⚡️ …

My dog ​​developed a tumor in his mouth. After visiting four veterinarians (including some in other countries), they all gave him no hope, saying he was going to die and that surgery was inoperable. Dr. H (Hermógenes) saw him right away and said we had to operate. The surgery went perfectly; he didn't have any gaps in his mouth, contrary to what other veterinarians had warned us about. He's still recovering, and we are very grateful to the Vetpro team.
A trustworthy clinic. They're always helpful and the assistants are very friendly. They always assist me or answer my questions. If you don't know where to go... visit them.
Excellent service and great professionalism. The staff treats both the animals and their owners with warmth and empathy. Highly recommended.

I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less. I took my puppy for a check-up, vaccination, and deworming. The check-up was absolutely terrible. They only looked at her ears and applied a €20 product to clean the wax, just to squeeze more money out of her. Then they told me that the vaccination and deworming couldn't be done together, which is completely false. To top it all off, shortly after the vaccination, she started scratching and coughing a lot. When I called, they told me it was totally normal and that if she kept biting her paws, I should bring her back on Monday to get a flea and tick treatment. SHE'S A TWO-MONTH-OLD PUPPY WHO HASN'T EVEN BEEN OUTSIDE! WHAT KIND OF TREATMENT ARE THEY GOING TO GIVE HER?! In the end, I had to take her to another vet for an emergency, and they told me they'd given her the third vaccine in the wrong place for the second. They also said she'd had an allergic reaction to the vaccine and they had to give her another shot, and they wanted me to wait until Monday—she might not even make it! I have to get her vaccinated again because it cancels out the effect of the previous shots. I don't understand how they're still open. I don't know where they got their degrees, but I can assure you they're not professionals.

Apparently, they're dedicated to deleting bad reviews for this place, so be very careful.

I've been going to this vet hospital for over six years, and the treatment and care for my dogs is undoubtedly the best. A special shout-out to H, who has been treating my 13-year-old dog for a long time, and I greatly value his experience, not to mention his wonderful character. I wholeheartedly recommend this center!

Once again, I had an emergency with my Toby, and if it weren't for you, it could have ended very badly. It all happened on a Sunday morning when he woke up with a very swollen face. Unfortunately, due to staff cuts at your hospital, it was closed, and we had to take him somewhere else. Although they were very kind and helpful there, they didn't treat his condition properly. The treatment only masked the real problem. The swelling seemed to improve, but after three days, it was much worse. We rushed to your clinic, and everything was done correctly. Surgery was performed immediately; they extracted two affected teeth, and there was already bone involvement.

In just 24 hours, my child was already improving.
Furthermore, as on other occasions, the care was 10 out of 10. Kindness, professionalism, but above all, empathy.
And as a side note, for other users who may not know this until today, I work in healthcare with people, and I notice everything, and I repeat, 10 out of 10. See the before and after photos. And thanks again.
I hope Sunday and evening hours can resume.
The best veterinary center in Barcelona!! 4 years taking care of my Ollie with the best service :) Highly recommended

I want to thank all the staff at the clinic who welcomed me so warmly from the very first day. I was very nervous about some tests my dog ​​had done at another vet that weren't clear. Hermógenes was very attentive and careful with my Piri, a Chihuahua in a lot of pain who doesn't let himself be touched easily, and he was able to examine him without any problem. They explained everything very clearly and are always quick to respond. A highly recommended and friendly clinic!
Thanks to Dr. H., we had our Shar Pei operated on and he did a fantastic job! He was incredibly professional! Thank you! 🤩 …
I miss having a 24-hour emergency service like they had a few years ago. I think that service should be reinstated.

H is, without a doubt, the best veterinarian we could have ever found. Goku, our German Shepherd, is very wary, and H won his trust from the very first moment. Thanks to H's approach, visits to the vet are much more bearable. We are delighted with the treatment from the entire team and deeply grateful to H for his professionalism, patience, and kindness.

I took my cat there a few months ago for a general check-up. The vet who saw her barely touched her. The first thing she talked about was running tests, more to make money than to actually treat her. They anesthetized her to draw blood… they'd never done that before. But of course, that was another €25… I absolutely do not recommend this place; they're more like rip-off artists than professionals.
To add to that, they gave my cat such a high level of anesthesia that she was drugged for two days… DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS THERE… the negative reviews I've read perfectly match my experience.

I've spent years searching for a veterinarian who combines true professionalism with genuine compassion, and I've finally found him. Dr. Hermógenes is, without a doubt, one of the best veterinarians I've ever worked with. His judgment is impeccable: he explains each diagnosis clearly, proposes evidence-based treatments, and never tries to "sell" anything unnecessary.

What I value most is his approach to animals: calm, patient, and with absolute respect. My dog ​​has trusted him since day one, and that says it all for me. Furthermore, the team at Hospital Veterinari Provença is efficient, friendly, and organized; it's incredibly reassuring to know you're leaving your pet in the hands of people who truly know what they're doing.

Excellent service, with a level of care that's increasingly rare. Highly recommended.

We received excellent care. The ophthalmologist, Hermogenes, showed great professionalism, empathy, and care for my pet. He explained every detail of the treatment and answered all my questions. Highly recommended.

Happy had a problem defecating due to a hernia in his colon. Dr. Hermogenes worked wonders in the operating room, and now he runs and defecates perfectly after a year of not being able to. Thank you VETPRO and your amazing team! Great job, congratulations!

Excellent service from the moment we arrived. The vet, Hermógenes, is wonderful with our Newfoundland's eyes; unfortunately, we haven't had good news, but he explains everything beautifully and is doing so much for her.
They have always taken great care of my pet and have treated us wonderfully.

Dr. Hermógenes treated our Penny for jaw cancer and extracted two teeth that were preventing her from eating. He was quick, caring, and professional, and he treated us so wonderfully! We are so happy with the clinic and all its staff! From the moment you walk in and are greeted at reception, you feel welcomed and very well taken care of. It's a 100 out of 10 clinic! Thank you all for how you treated and helped us.
A huge thank you to the whole team and especially to Dr. Hermogenes for his care and the solution he found for our cat Penny. 😻😻😻😻 …
Fantastic ophthalmology service, very friendly and professional.

The veterinary clinic is fantastic, incredibly friendly, and they always treat our pets with so much care. The facilities are clean and modern, and the veterinarians make you feel right at home. Plus, they always respond quickly and explain everything clearly. If you want a trustworthy place where your furry friend will be well taken care of, this is the place.

We have been clients of the clinic for years and I want to highlight the professionalism and quality of its staff. We love Dr. Hermogenes; he is a very good professional and helped us a lot in preparing a trip to Thailand with all the documentation. Everything was perfect. We were completely lost. He was a great help.

Excellent service and care at the Veterinary Clinic. The veterinary team is very professional and friendly, and it's clear they love animals. My pet received exceptional treatment, and the service was quick and efficient.

I truly find the service to be very efficient, friendly, and professional, starting with the reception procedures for the staff. Since I started taking my pet, Thor 🐾, to Dr. Hermogenes, his diagnoses have always been very accurate, the treatments are effective, and he has a very friendly, patient, and professional approach with the animals.

Thank you so much for your care, professionalism, and friendly manner.
Excellent service, especially from the veterinarian Salazar.

Excellent service! The staff are incredibly kind, charismatic, attentive, and highly professional. I took my dog ​​in, and she was seen promptly. The care and love they show the animals is evident, and the advice they gave me on how to provide her with the best care in every way was invaluable.

Thank you, Sara and H, for such wonderful service. I am very grateful, and so is my dog.
Excellent veterinarians provide care with great love and dedication.

H and Sara are excellent veterinarians!! They saved my dog ​​from death! I went in for an emergency because my dog ​​was choking on a ball, and they acted incredibly fast. Thank you so much to the whole team, I would definitely go back!

Hermógenes is my French bulldog Vito's vet, and I'm very happy with his services. He's a true professional.
Likewise, everyone at Vetpro has always treated me very well. Highly recommended.

I've been taking my Pug to the Veterinary Center for several years now, and he's always received exceptional care. I especially want to highlight Dr. H, a true professional whose dedication and affection for animals is evident from the very first moment.

I have complete confidence in him and the entire team: they always explain each diagnosis clearly, offer the best treatment options, and genuinely care about our pets' well-being. Furthermore, the facilities are always clean and well-equipped, and the service is quick and efficient.

Without a doubt, this is a completely trustworthy center that I wholeheartedly recommend. My dog ​​always leaves feeling calm and well cared for, and that's priceless.
My experience with Clínica Provença is excellent. They are very professional and answer all your questions about your pet's health. Their attention and friendliness are top-notch.
They have always treated me very well. With service by message and everything on the same day for any little thing. There at the establishment everything is always perfect!

Dr. H always treats us with great care and kindness. He's a very professional ophthalmologist and very concerned about our pets. We arrived very nervous, not knowing what to do, but with his guidance, Elvis pulled through and is very happy. We recommend him 100%! Best regards!
Pay attention to the negative reviews; the positive ones are fabricated to cover up the terrible service they provide to animals. DO NOT take them there.
Always excellent service. Very good veterinarians and assistants. As always, Hermógenes is my trusted veterinarian! Thank you so much!

Wonderful treatment, great professionals, quick attention.
Highly recommended for both routine visits and emergencies. 100% recommended
I've been going to this clinic for 5 years, I recommend it. They treat my dog ​​well, and whenever I've gone for emergencies, they've been very helpful.

They're not qualified to provide care. They told me my dog ​​has an enlarged heart but that they could examine him in four days (what's the point of that?). I also had to take him to the emergency room because he has advanced pneumonia, and the x-ray didn't show anything about it. My dog ​​had a fever and was being given the wrong medication because I was already taking him for follow-up appointments. They're not qualified; please put someone with experience in charge. I went to another place, and as soon as they saw everything, they told me my dog ​​had advanced pneumonia and even needed oxygen. I don't want this to happen to anyone else.

I took my cat to have his nails trimmed and it seemed like it was the first time they had done it, they were more afraid than the cat and I knew more about methods so that the cat wouldn't get scared than they did.
LACK OF PROFESSIONALISM

One of his nails was stuck in it and they were unable to remove it, I was stunned when they told me to do it at home and treat it myself.
TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE.

I asked for the vet and there was no answer, there was no vet.
MONUMENTAL SCAM

I finally left with the cat traumatized.
A paw dripping with blood and without any preventive care.
They only cut his front nails and one of his back nails.
A nail stuck in the pad and they refused to remove it.
The treatment towards the customer is terrible.
INTOLERABLE and REPORTABLE

Been going to this clinic for 5 years with my dog who is 5 years now. Never anything urgent, was surprised they never looked at the history of the visits when visitings again but well.
This time we did go with urgency, my dog was vomiting, losing balance, they said they couldn’t find anything out of the ordinary but they could keep her until the evening. Came back in the evening, they said she seemed fine so i could take her home.. obviously with a nice bill..
While walking outside she seemed extremely unstable and slow.. but took there ‘professional’ advise and went home.. 1 week later my dog cannot move, is shaking, doesn’t eat. We went to another clinic as this one didn’t have time, my dog is still suffering and they are trying to find the cause but at least i have the feeling they take it serious and they care..

*update* In the other clinic within 3 days they found out she had a brain tumor and was at the edge of dying.. immediately had to start treatment. They were the kindest at this clinic and I was able to visit her while she was attached to wires and an iv etc. At vet provenca you were never allowed to go downstairs where the dogs were staying over night.. Which feels shady..

If you care for your pet, please do not go to this clinic. Been going for 5 years and my overall impression is they do not care, do not take their time, nor take things serious..

I took my dog ​​there last Friday. They told me they had activated his microchip, but they hadn't. They sent him some deworming medication, and he's still vomiting and has diarrhea. They charged us around 300 euros. I don't recommend them, and the service is terrible. There are about four people there, just chatting and not doing anything... awful service. Today, Friday, I called because my dog ​​is still sick with the same bloody diarrhea and isn't eating. They won't give him his medication, and when I called, they told me they aren't responsible. The puppy is only three months old; all they care about is the money they charge. Besides, the puppy is registered in the name of a man, my ex-partner. I'm reporting this man, Francisco Sanchez Rodriguez, and the veterinary clinic for doing nothing. I think my puppy only has days left... Thanks for killing my dog.

WE DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS VETERINARIAN DUE TO LACK OF PROFESSIONALISM AND ABUSIVE PRACTICES

I am deeply disappointed and want to make it clear: I do not recommend anyone go to this veterinarian. They do not have qualified professionals, and their way of operating is closer to a scam than animal care.

On Saturday, August 16th, we left our dog under their supervision for observation. During that time, he ate a puppy pad, a fact they never informed us about. We only found out when he started defecating plastic in our home. This demonstrates a complete lack of supervision and responsibility on the part of the clinic.

The dog has been vomiting and expelling plastic, clearly in poor condition, for days, and the only response we received from the veterinarian was that "we have to wait." They charged us €300 for an ineffective service and only refunded €30 for an ultrasound, which, according to them, was the only thing necessary to check if he was okay. More than 10 days have passed, and our dog remains lethargic, unwell, and without any real solution.

When I asked to speak to a senior manager, they told me it wasn't possible, since the owners aren't even veterinarians. Unbelievable. The service has been appalling, and the trust we had after taking our dog there for five years has been completely lost.

To top it all off, after assuring me during the consultation that my dog ​​would expel the plastic in eight days, when that didn't happen, their justification was that "my dog ​​isn't a German Shepherd." Excuse me? Not only did they give a wrong diagnosis, but now they're trying to blame my dog's breed for their own negligence.

In short, the treatment, the lack of professionalism, and the way they evade responsibility mean I can only say: DO NOT go to this veterinarian. They don't take responsibility, they don't care for the animals, and they deceive their clients.

Excellent service from the veterinary, support, and auxiliary team at the center. We took our dog Bruno there for a chronic case of otitis that required surgery. Veterinarian Hermógenes was clear from the beginning and provided the professional warmth and support that Bruno's case deserved. The support team was also very kind during the post-operative period, providing all necessary care and treatments. We are very satisfied with the service and feel confident continuing to take Bruno to this center. Thank you so much!

It's excellent! The medical and administrative team knows how to take care of your pet from the moment you arrive at the clinic. They provide follow-up by phone and WhatsApp. The treatment is timely and appropriate for each case. Special thanks to Veterinarian Hermógenes!

Taking my cat Tyson to Dr. Hermógenes is always a positive experience. His professionalism and dedication are evident from the very first moment: he explains everything clearly, listens attentively, and inspires tremendous confidence. In addition to his excellent medical knowledge, you can see the genuine affection with which he treats animals.

Tyson is always calm in his hands, and that says it all for me. He's a veterinarian who combines experience, sensitivity, and a true passion for his work.

I am so grateful for the impeccable care Tyson receives at every visit. I recommend Dr. Hermógenes without hesitation!

Fantastic clinic! We took our dog in for a wart on his head, and they treated him incredibly well and incredibly quickly! Our dog is doing great now!!! Thank you for all the care! We'll definitely be back.

DO NOT take your dogs there! We took our dog there because she was incontinence. They did blood and urine tests and sent us home. The problem persisted, so we took her back, and they did an ultrasound and found a lump in one of her adrenal glands. They gave us medication and also performed a biopsy, concluding that it wasn't a malignant tumor. The dog continued to incontinence despite the €50 a month medication. We took her back again, and without our consent, they performed several more tests. The cost had already reached €1,000, and the dog was still the same. We had been on medication and absurd tests for a year. I asked for her entire medical history and took her to another veterinarian. The result: a malignant tumor in the adrenal gland, and the dog had emergency surgery. If it hadn't been for my intuition to take her somewhere else, she would be dead today. She went a year with the tumor undiagnosed!

I've been taking my dog ​​to this clinic since he was 5 months old, and now he's almost 2. It's been mostly emergency visits, and he was neutered when he was 1. I have no complaints about the professionals, neither about the veterinarian Laia, who saw us on most visits, nor about the surgeon Hermógenes (I hope I spelled his name right). The only thing I have noticed is that both during the night shift (which they no longer offer) and on summer days, for example, the professionalism of the staff who attended us was low. In my opinion, they were very young and inexperienced, which makes it hard to feel safe or professional during a delicate situation like taking your pet to the emergency room.

I think it's difficult to find a truly excellent veterinary clinic, and this one could maintain its good reputation if the company didn't cut costs on staff, as the service offered will inevitably suffer.

I hope this review helps owners reconsider these aspects and the potential loss of loyal customers.

Thank you. Best regards!

I went to have my dog ​​operated on for cataracts. He was so blind he was falling down stairs and bumping into lampposts. He had the surgery and is now perfectly fine. Everything was great, and Dr. Salazar was a wonderful professional and provided excellent service.

As always, the service is outstanding. Laia and the assistants pamper our furry friends and give them the best care.
Thank you. Highly recommended!
Amazing

The only reason I'm not giving them 5 stars is because they used to operate 24 hours a day, which gave me a lot of peace of mind, and that hasn't been the case for some time now. I understand the reasons behind the decision, because they communicated it in advance and provided context, but the fact that they were open 24 hours a day was the main reason I chose them when I moved to the neighborhood about two years ago and was comparing clinics. If an emergency arises at night now, I can't count on them, and that worries me.

That aside, my furry friends and I are very happy with this clinic for several reasons: they usually have good availability for appointments, all the staff are very friendly, they have several communication channels, and they have the means to provide immediate results for the most common tests (more complex tests do have to be sent to a lab, but the results also come back quite quickly).

Besides routine vaccinations and checkups, they operated on my Jack there for what's called "cherry eye," and not only did the operation go very well, but they must have treated him with extra care because Jack doesn't usually get along well with people, yet every time we go he's happy and greets all the staff enthusiastically. We've also had to go several times for my Joy, because she's prone to ear infections, and where other vets couldn't, they did, as their approach was more meticulous.
We were served very quickly and with a very friendly approach.
This is the clinic I've trusted ever since I got Barney; everyone is fantastic, from the first to the last. A perfect ten.
Everything was perfect as always. Hermógenes is the best vet I've ever had.
Very friendly, super nice, and they treat your pet wonderfully.
I took my 15-year-old dog to the vet and everything was excellent. Very friendly service and a quick diagnosis. Thank you for treating my pet so well.
Great service from the whole team at the center💗. …
Everything was great, thank you so much!!!
Excellent service and Laia is very caring and efficient with pets.
I called half an hour before closing time and they wouldn't understand me! They're useless!
Today at Vetpro, our pet Dama received excellent care and the vaccination went smoothly. Veterinarian Sergi Beltrán and Dama got along famously 🐶❤️ …

I'D GIVE THEM LESS THAN ONE STAR!
From the start, the girl who answers the phone is a know-it-all, and when you ask about neutering, she forces you to do pre-anesthetic tests, even though they're optional. They've gone from a veterinary hospital to a clinic because they no longer have an emergency service (THEY SHOULD CHANGE THE NAME OF THE PLACE!). An operation that cost €194 in July they now want to charge €365 for. They're price gougers who are only out to rip you off.

We are incredibly grateful for the care and attention we received.
It hasn't been the best of times for us, as our dog Zar had to undergo surgery twice, and ultimately, a happy ending wasn't possible.

But we know that everything possible was done and that the animal's well-being always took precedence over any financial gain they might have made by prolonging the situation with more surgeries, treatments, etc.
The surgeon, Hermogenes, is a 10 out of 10 both as a person and as a professional. He was incredibly empathetic and always available to reassure us and provide any necessary explanations.
Thank you so much to the entire team for their dedication.
The treatment by the veterinarians and staff is very good.

We're very happy with this veterinarian, especially Dr. Sara. She's always treated us perfectly.
The prices for some treatments are high.

I took my dog ​​for an abdominal ultrasound at this center, recommended by my health insurance company. I was informed that the cost would be €34 plus VAT, but when I paid, they charged me over €60, claiming an additional fee for the professional. I contacted the insurance company again, and they confirmed that the agreed price already included the professional service, so this extra charge seems excessive and disrespectful of the agreements with insurance companies.

Furthermore, the treatment during the ultrasound left much to be desired. They held my dog ​​too roughly, without the gentleness that an anxious animal needs. To make matters worse, while they were performing the ultrasound, another veterinarian came in to talk to the technician, who was following the conversation without paying constant attention to the screen.

Finally, I decided to take my dog ​​to another center, and the diagnosis I received was different, which demonstrates the lack of precision in their service.

They overcharge, get distracted during an important procedure, and don't offer a reliable diagnosis. A frustrating and disappointing experience. I absolutely do not recommend it.
